kpis.description_fr: Carnet de commandes (backlog) groupe. KPI signature des EPC oil & gas, visibilité multi-année. Record historique post-cycle FID offshore 2023-2025.
kpis.description_en: Group order backlog. Signature KPI of EPC oil & gas, multi-year visibility. Historical record post offshore FID cycle 2023-2025.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio prises de commandes / CA. >1 = backlog en croissance. Cycle haussier soutenu par investissements offshore Moyen-Orient, Brésil, Guyana.
kpis.description_en: Order intake / revenue ratio. >1 = backlog growing. Bullish cycle from offshore investments in Middle East, Brazil, Guyana.

kpis.description_fr: EBITDA segment Asset Based Services (flotte offshore drilling + construction). Capitalisable, levier pricing day-rate offshore.
kpis.description_en: Asset Based Services EBITDA (offshore drilling + construction fleet). Capital-heavy, levered to offshore day-rates pricing.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Offshore E&C (pipeline pose, SURF, fixed offshore). Croissance tirée par projets Qatar, Saudi Aramco, Petrobras Brésil.
kpis.description_en: Offshore E&C revenue (pipelay, SURF, fixed offshore). Growth driven by Qatar, Saudi Aramco, Petrobras Brazil projects.

_notes: Saipem : KPIs EPC oil & gas (backlog + book-to-bill = signature de l'industrie) + segments Asset Based + Offshore E&C. Cycle haussier 2023-2025.
